concepts.controls:
Left / Right or A / D: Carve and aim your spray
Space: Jump off a snowman ramp
Left + Right in the air: Spin for trick points
Enter: Start / restart
concepts.core_mechanic: Carving sprays a real arc of snow behind you. Spray the yeti in the face to blind and slow him, but hard carves also slow you down — so you have to zigzag between safe speed and desperate snow-blasting. Riding straight into a snowman launches you off its belly for a spin trick, and a clean landing dumps a huge spray burst behind you.
concepts.juice: Snow spray particles arc from the board on every carve, a white splash bursts across the yeti's face when blinded, and landing a spin pops floating text like '360! +300' with a squash-and-stretch landing. The screen gives a tiny shake when you clip a tree and a bigger shake as the yeti lunges. A carved trench trail fades behind your board. Title screen: 'POWDER PANIC!' over the grinning snowboarder, with 'Press Enter — Don't Let Him Wipe His Face!' underneath.
concepts.lose: The yeti catches you, shown by him filling the screen with 'GOTCHA!' Or you crash into three trees, shown by three cracked-goggle icons emptying and 'WIPEOUT!'
concepts.palette: Fresh white snow, crayon-yellow jacket, pine green, flag red, and icy pale blue for the yeti.
concepts.pitch: Race one steep scrolling run to the finish flags at the bottom while the yeti thunders down right behind you. Your only brake on him is the snow you kick up — carve, fly off snowmen, land tricks, and keep his face full of powder.

roles.role: The big central hero sprite you carve downhill, tilting and squashing as it rides and spins in midair.
Crayon pine obstacles planted across the slope; clipping one costs a crash and shakes loose a puff of green needles and snow.
A friendly ramp — hit one square-on to launch into the air for spin tricks; it wobbles and loses its carrot for a second, then pops back up.
Red gate flags in pairs marking the fastest line down, plus a giant checkered row of them at the finish at the bottom.
The huge pursuer looming at the top of the screen, gaining whenever you ride clean and falling back when you blind him with spray, wipe three crashes and he grabs you.

concepts.title: Powder Panic!
concepts.win: Cross the finish flags before the yeti grabs you. 'YOU MADE IT DOWN!' shows with your trick score and best combo.

concepts.controls:
Left / Right or A / D: Carve to the beat
Up / Down or W / S: Duck and pop
Space: Trick, only on the beat
Enter: Start / restart
concepts.core_mechanic: You can only move on the yeti's stomp-beat. The whole mountain pulses once per beat — trees bounce, flag poles wobble — and a carve or trick pressed exactly on that pulse is Perfect and builds your combo, while off-beat presses do nothing but make the boarder wobble. Every 8 Perfect beats stacks one snowball beside you; a full snowman shield rolls with you and smashes one tree for free, then bursts.
concepts.juice: A shrinking ring closes on the boarder each beat, flashing 'PERFECT!', 'GOOD', or 'TOO LATE!' in bouncing combo text. Trees thump and shed snow on the beat, the yeti's stomp makes a bass screen-pulse, and trick landings spray confetti-like snow. Snowballs visibly stack into a snowman as your combo grows. Title screen: 'STOMPBEAT SLOPE' with all five drawings bobbing in time and 'Press Enter on the Beat!'
concepts.lose: Miss too many beats and the yeti stomps his way up to you. 'THE YETI CAUGHT THE BEAT — AND YOU!' Or crash into three unshielded trees: 'OFF BEAT, OFF BOARD!'
concepts.palette: Twilight purple-blue slope so the white beat ring, red flags, green trees, and yellow jacket pop like stage lights.
concepts.pitch: The yeti's stomping sets the tempo for the whole mountain, and you can only carve, duck, and trick exactly on his beat. Chain Perfect moves to build a rolling snowman shield and ride the full 75-second song to the finish flags.

roles.role: The hero riding down the center lane, who carves, ducks, and spins only when your input lands on the beat.
Beat-keeping obstacles that bounce on every stomp to show the tempo; hit one without a snowman shield and you lose combo and a life.
Your combo made visible — Perfect chains stack snowballs next to the track until a full snowman rolls beside you as a one-hit shield.
Gate flags that flap exactly on the beat you must carve through them; passing one on-beat extends the combo, passing off-beat just rustles it.
The giant drummer at the top of the slope whose stomps drive the music, the beat ring, and the chase — he gains a step on every missed beat.

concepts.title: Stompbeat Slope
concepts.win: Survive to the end of the song and cross the finish flags. 'FULL COMBO FINALE!' or 'YOU OUT-RODE THE BEAT!' shows with your Perfect count.

concepts.controls:
Arrow Keys / WASD: Slide one move
Space: Plant a flag / restart a push (undo last slide)
Enter: Start / restart the level
concepts.core_mechanic: On this icy grid you never walk — every press sends the snowboarder sliding until a tree, snowman, or wall stops him, and he can shove one snowman ahead of him as he goes. The twist: after every slide, the yeti takes one step that copies the direction of your last slide. So you solve each room by using your own moves to remote-control the yeti, luring him onto the red flag to freeze him in a sulk while you park every snowman on its marked spot.
concepts.juice: The boarder leans hard and leaves a sparkling ice trail on every slide, snowmen scoot with a wobble and a carrot-bob, and the yeti stomps one tile with a mini screen-shake and a puff of frost each time he copies you. Parking a snowman pops 'ONE DOWN!' and plants its hat with a sparkle; trapping the yeti on the flag triggers a goofy frozen-yeti pose and 'YETI PARKED!' Title screen: 'YETI PARKING PUZZLE' on a hand-drawn ice grid with 'Press Enter — Slide Smart, He Copies You!'
concepts.lose: The yeti steps onto your tile: 'GOTCHA! He copied you right into a corner.' Or push a snowman into a dead corner with no way out: 'THAT SNOWMAN'S STUCK! Press Enter to retry.'
concepts.palette: Pale ice-blue grid, white snow, and the warm yellow jacket and red flags as the two bright focal colors.
concepts.pitch: Slide across a frozen puzzle yard where you can't stop on your own, pushing snowmen onto their spots one slick move at a time. Every slide you make teaches the yeti your last direction — use that to park him on a flag before he corners you.

roles.role: Your sliding piece, who glides in a straight line until something stops him and can push one snowman at a time.
Fixed pine blockers that stop your slides and give you the angles you need to line up pushes.
The pushable pieces — slide them onto the dotted snow circles to clear the room; push one into a corner and the puzzle is stuck.
Both the yeti trap and the goal marker: lure the yeti onto the big red flag to freeze him, which unlocks the exit flag at the edge of the yard.
A turn-based chaser who takes exactly one step after each of your slides, copying your last direction — a menace you can steer like a second puzzle piece.

concepts.title: Yeti Parking Puzzle
concepts.win: Park every snowman on its dotted spot and freeze the yeti on the flag, then slide out the exit. 'SLOPE CLEARED!' shows in under two minutes across 5 hand-made rooms of increasing trickiness, ending with 'THE MOUNTAIN IS YOURS!'
